split_policy.rule: T-B02 held-out set. Every repository here is unseen by retrieval-policy tuning: none appears in retrieval-policy-v1 or heldout-language-rotation-2026-08-02. The 2026-08-02 rotation panel is deliberately excluded because its cross-repo recall moved (0.841 -> 0.886) during the OW-AC-03 tuning window, so it can no longer support a head-to-head claim. No repository here may be used to tune retrieval; a fix motivated by these tasks retires the suite.
